principals.name: U
principals.description: The initiator: initially holds its identity and long-term signing key, V's public verification key or credential, and its proposal/application inputs; it sends message_1, verifies V's signature in message_2, and signs message_3.

principals.name: V
principals.description: The responder: initially holds its identity and long-term signing key, U's public verification key or credential, and its selection/application inputs; it processes message_1, signs message_2, and verifies U's signature in message_3.

values.name: pk_U
values.description: U's public verification key, computed from sk_U. The document lets ID_U either carry U's credential in message_3 or only identify it, with V retrieving the credential out of band, so V is not assumed to store it beforehand.

values.name: pk_V
values.description: V's public verification key, computed from sk_V. The document lets ID_V either carry V's credential in message_2 or only identify it, with U retrieving the credential out of band, so U is not assumed to store it beforehand.

values.name: ID_U
values.description: U's identifier for its own public key or credential; it either contains the credential or uniquely identifies it.

values.name: ID_V
values.description: V's identifier for its own public key or credential; it either contains the credential or uniquely identifies it.

values.name: ECDH_Curves_U
values.description: The ECDH curves U supports, in decreasing order of preference; the list is fixed.

values.name: HKDFs_U
values.description: The ECDH-SS w/ HKDF algorithms U supports.

values.name: SIGs_V
values.description: The signature algorithms with which U supports verification.

values.name: SIGs_U
values.description: The signature algorithms with which U supports signing.

values.name: HINT_ID_U
values.description: U's optional information on how to retrieve its own credential (for example a URI).

values.name: HINT_ID_V
values.description: V's optional information on how to retrieve its own credential (for example a URI).
